question: 当实际并发序列数超过 N_max 时，vLLM 的自动降载机制将 batch size 降至 N_max，导致吞吐量下降比例为 (1 - N_max / requested_seqs)；例如请求 8 条 32k 序列时，N_max=9，无降载；请求 8 条 64k 序列时，N_max=4，吞吐量下降 50%。

sources.title: Performance and Tuning — vLLM
sources.snippet: By default, it is set to 512, which has the best ITL on A100 in the initial benchmark (llama 70B and mixtral 8x22B). Smaller max_num_batched_tokens achieves better ITL because there are fewer prefills interrupting decodes. Higher max_num_batched_tokens achieves better TTFT as you can put more prefill to the batch.
